Subject: Draft MAP & procurement timing — Novus pilot next steps

Hi Jordan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and the next steps we agreed on during the discovery: attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level highlights: 

- Pilot scope: 3 endpoints (chat, embeddings, reranking) + usage cap for initial 90 days
- Proposed milestones:
  1) Finalize SOW & pricing (owner: Novus / Novus legal) — target: 2027-08-10
  2) Contract signature (owner: Novus procurement + Redwood legal) — target: 2027-08-20
  3) Private deployment test window (owner: Redwood infra + Novus eng) — start: 2027-08-22
  4) Production cutover & monitoring handoff — target: 2027-08-31

Dependencies called out in the MAP: procurement lead time, SOC 2 evidence for the sandbox, and SSO configuration. I added tentative owners next to each milestone in the sheet.

Two asks from our side to keep the runway clean: 
- Can you confirm procurement signature deadline (we penciled 2027-08-20) or suggest a firm date?
- Can Novus legal review and come back with any redlines by 2027-08-12 so Redwood legal can turn around a negotiated doc the following week?

If helpful, I can put together a 30-min alignment call this week to go through milestone owners and adjust dates — availability below.

Availability (PT): Wed 08/03 10:00–11:30, Thu 08/04 13:00–15:00, Fri 08/05 09:00–12:00. 

Attachments: Novus_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan

Thanks, Tessa — good recap and the MAP looks useful. Forwarding to our procurement and procurement lead (cc'd Sonia). A few notes inline and a couple asks: 

> 1) Finalize SOW & pricing — target: 2027-08-10
We can aim for 08/10 for the SOW internal alignment but our legal will need at least one full week for review. Can you confirm whether the version you're sending is intended to be the SOW+exhibits or a high-level SOW and the final SOW will follow signature?

> 2) Contract signature — target: 2027-08-20
Procurement is tight on headcount this month — Sonia asked for the signature runway to be 2027-08-25 to allow for PO creation and our internal approvals. If Redwood needs a hard signature by 08/20 we will escalate, but 08/25 is more realistic for Novus. 

> Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence, SSO
We require SOC 2 Type II evidence and a short SSO implementation checklist. I attached our procurement checklist (novus_procurement_checklist.pdf) for reference.

If we can shift the signature target to 08/25, we will commit to providing redlines back to Redwood legal by 2027-08-18. That gives our legal + procurement team two business days to complete PO & signature on 08/25.

Let's align on a 30-min call Thursday 08/04 at 13:30 PT if that works for you and Ben.

—Jordan
